parsed.reason: Multiple critical failures: (1) The question asks for the capital of France in French; the answer completely ignores this and responds about weather instead. (2) Does not answer the actual question at all - "Paris" is the correct answer and isn't mentioned. (3) Invents specific data ("24 degrees and sunny tomorrow") without live access. (4) Points to an app/website. (5) Offers future action ("set a reminder"). (6) Includes greeting ("Great question!"), emoji, and ends with a question. This violates nearly every principle of a sharp response.
